extension.summary: Kodi diagnostics, Add-on Doctor, install history and crash correlation
extension.description: Standalone RC3-based Health Center candidate: fresh unified local health reporting; scoped authorization recovery; verified bounded Auto Repair; required dependency checks and verified Kodi install outcomes; preserved cached inventory, repository review/disable/restore/history, grouped logs, Android/native exit explanations, Crash Center, recorder and diagnostic exports. Skin Export uses skin.infinity.diggz. Individually checked backup snapshots and archive integrity verification; not globally atomic. Complete Restore, shared cache cleanup and direct repository file maintenance are explicitly unavailable without a separately approved compatible maintenance controller. Health Orb remains the protected Command Center UIHealth/Guardian/StartupWatchdog scope. Physical Galaxy Fold acceptance is pending. No native/APK, skin or Command Center changes.
